description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. Delta Regional Authority (DRA) grant funding cycles and announced awards, from DRA's own public site (dra.gov), SEDAP, the Community Infrastructure Fund, the Delta Workforce Grant Program, Strategic Planning, and disaster-recovery addenda. DRA grants go to local governments, nonprofits, and tribes across its eight-state region (AL, AR, IL, KY, LA, MS, MO, TN) and are not listed on Grants.gov. Filter by keyword, program, record type, or recipient state. Results include deadlines, award ranges, eligibility, and source links. Present as information only; do not frame results as an eligibility determination or application recommendation. One search counts as one use, regardless of how many records are returned. Every record carries a direct source link (or source name and record ID) so you can verify and cite the underlying record.
